top_reviews.content: Came here for the first time winter break at UCB. The staff treated me like I was the only person in the world (I was the only in the restaurant), but extremely professional and attentive. Serving warm water is such a nice touch I wish more places offered. I ordered the spring rolls and the pad Thai. Both absolutely fresh and delicious. Potions are very generous. I will be back here, and brining my friends!

Came in here for a late night meal. I wasn’t expecting the inside to look so fancy haha. Great atmosphere and the waiter was really friendly despite the hour. The clear noodle soup was easy on the stomach yet extremely flavorful — lots of white pepper and other seasonings so I didn’t need to use any additional sauces. Tons of noodles and delicious chicken as well. It was exactly what I needed after a long day :)

I was staying at the Holiday Inn and they say that this option was "kinda good."  They were much larger than I expected, with a great menu, and wonderful service.  That was the best Pad Thai I'd ever had!  It was completely empty for most of my meal; they should be doing better business!

I was delivered food from here that had a small rock in it. It chipped my tooth. When i called to tell them and ask how they’ll fix it, they told me to call uber support for a refund??? Because it was delivered through uber eats (their own website has a delivery option which does not work). They did not offer to help in any other way. Stay away!!

I had Pra Ram with chicken and Chicken Satay. It was absolutely delicious. What I appreciate it most is that they gave plenty of peanut sauce. A lot of Thai restaurants skimp on the sauce, but not this one. I also enjoyed the authentic environment of the restaurant. The restroom left something to be desired in the way of cleanliness, but I didn't let it take away from my enjoyment of this experience.

top_reviews.content:
Cute little place with a clean, welcoming atmosphere. The food was good overall, but there’s definitely room for improvement. The appetizer was tasty and enjoyable, but the rack of lamb was underwhelming and didn’t quite live up to expectations.

We’ll give Soi 4 Bangkok Eatery another try and hopefully see some improvements. If things get better, I’ll be happy to update my review.

I’ve gone many times for happy hour - their happy hour menu is amazing! I especially love their mustard leaf wraps, they are so fresh and a wonderful refreshing burst of flavor. I do prefer their happy hour menu to their regular menu. For dinner time the space is full and a little loud (still able to talk fine), but generally at happy hour it’s a low volume level. Cute place!

Had a lovely dinner at  Thai restaurant Soi 4.

We started with their Kirimaya cocktail (Knob Creek, orange bitters & lemongrass syrup).

For appetizers we had baked green mussels, mustard leaf rolls, and a cucumber salad.

For main courses, the shrimp & eggplant stir fry, and the pan-roasted sole with mango, ginger and fried brussel sprouts.

The food was very good but I believe the sole was actually flounder.
Had lunch here today and was impressed. Their food is fresh and the flavors are spot on. We both had the lunch rice bowls, which were good sized servings. I needed to take half home with me!

Five stars are not enough! If you’re looking for a place where food excellence and outstanding service come together, this is it! My girlfriend and I decided to visit after we admired the beautiful setting a month ago. Fast forward to today, and we finally got to experience the food.

The teamwork at this restaurant is a well-orchestrated effort. We were greeted and seated promptly, and our drinks were ready in no time. I had the Numi Tea, while my date ordered the Thai Tea. Although the tea was wonderful, it was just a prelude to the amazing meal that followed.

I ordered Miang Kum with tofu substituted for shrimp, but I can’t imagine it could have been any more flavorful. We sat there, amazed, trying to savor every bite. We’re already looking forward to coming back for the Chicken Satay, Choo Chee Salmon, Gai Gra Prow, and Coconut Rice!

If you look beyond the locality and the surrounding businesses, you will discover delicious soul food here. To much going on outside the business but the food was great being from Oakland you have no fear and being a Christian believing God and trusting him you will always be safe from harm

The best dried fried ribs 😋
I come from Dunnigan, CA. To get them,  I also stop by when I have a doctor's appointment in San Francisco.  It's a 2-hour drive for me because of the traffic,  but if I'm coming from the city, I stop by, so I was there on Aug 31 and also Sept 5. My rating as an unbiased local college student and hobbyist foodie with somewhat of a strict rating scale.

- the overall flavor was amazing; the ricotta, the parm finish, the sauce, i was a delectable experience and the only con was that i got a 20” instead of a 10” because I this pie was inhaled in no more than 2 minutes.

- both indoor and outdoor seating so theres an option for everyone
- i sat outside and thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere and livelihood of the area
- felt cozy but at the same time there was so much seating

Service: (4.2/5)
- standard service and what you’d expect from a local shop
- self serve water and again the whole thing of ranch was a nice touch bumping it up from a little higher than a 4

Overall rating: (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️)

SUMMARY/ tldr
Would i go again? Yes
Good pizza and atmosphere with reasonable pricing as the cherry on top.

You might be able to get a table on the sidewalk at this absolutely bangin', easily top 3 east bay pizza spot, but mostly this is a tiny takeout spot -- though you might be compelled to finish your slice or pie before your even reach your car.

NYC style crispy crust pies cooked well done have a very satisfying initial crunch when you bite into it. Stellar ingredients a decent selection of slices and special pies, Pizza Ponte snuck under the radar without much fanfare, but should make everyone's top east bay list.

Hands down the best NY style pizza in the Bay Area! The only comparison I can think of is L’Industrie in NYC. If you don’t believe me, try it for yourself…and thank me later!

Two brothers with a great founding story.

And yes, the buffalo pizza is worth trying.

THE BEST PIZZA IN THE BAY 🍕🏙️ I haven’t had pizza this good in years since I was last in New York! Their pizza is so thin and crispy… you can hear the crunch when you take your first bite. And the flavoring of the sauces 10/10. The staff is also so sweet on top of it! I’ve been coming here since before their remodeling and there’s a really cute upstairs dining area!  I come here at least once a week from South Bay — enough said 🔥 get their Genoa pesto pizza, it won’t disappoint!

I had the green goddess pizza and it was delicious! The crust was light and airy. Crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. Their green goddess pizza is full of flavor. Would definitely recommend this place.

top_reviews.content:
Open late on Sundays when most other places are closed in the area. Sushi was very reasonably priced and satisfying. The tea was loose leaf and not from a bag which we prefer.

Service was everything I expected and it has a cozy homey vibe. No frills, no pomp, but what I was looking for.

Simple, inexpensive, clean Japanese food! Look at all the seafood in my nabeyaki for a low price. Yum

The tofu in the nabeyaki was very flavorful

I like it here, the taste is very good. Before starting our ordered meal, they gave us a free soup that we really enjoy drinking. The avocado on top of the caterpillar roll is very fresh. We will come back again.

Mediocre, poorly cut sushi. The salmon was particularly disappointing, the unagi was not well rendered, the scallops were good. The price was decent, that's a plus. I got six pieces of nigiri. Usually a small portioning of rice is a good thing, but in this case the rice under the fish was so small that I could barely hold the piece of nigiri without it falling apart and there were scraggly bits of fish dangling so it was messy to eat, like it was cut with a dull knife. Just bizarre. The greeting I received when I got there was not warm and not friendly, like they didn't want me there. Definitely not welcoming. I've never been there before so I sat down anyway, I wanted to try. She seemed very disappointed that it was just me, alone, having lunch. Strange vibe. I finished quickly and tipped well, the only smile I got there was when I was done and said I was ready for the check. They just didn't like me on sight? No idea. I definitely wouldn't return.

Great rolls, great prices, beautiful interior despite small space.

On my first visit, I decided to get some avocado rolls and I found this restaurant. I paid $8.60 for two avocado maki rolls, each roll being six pieces. The avocado was ripe and the rolls were a good size. If you decide to visit this restaurant, you should dine-in. This restaurant does to-go orders, but they're really dine-in oriented.

On a different visit, I dined in and had the chicken donburi, California roll, and mushroom roll. The chicken donburi was filling, the California roll was wonderful, but the mushroom roll was extremely salty. My total was $21.55 before tax.

This restaurant has great prices and great food, which is why I recommend checking it out.

top_reviews.content:
While my wife chilled in the car and I picked up my tags next door she noticed this spot and suggested I walk in and order a pie. The reviews seemed solid and I wasn't disappointed. The guy taking orders was chill, no frills easy ordering, took what seemed like less than 20 minutes.

We ordered a large half pepperoni, half chicken special. It was damn delicious... Lots of toppings but not soggy, decent dough with some chew, and piping hot, just a real solid pizza. For that size and toppings it was a little pricey closer to 40 bucks, but we easily got two big meals out of that big ol' pizza. Note: they put the pepperoni in-between generous layers of cheese, don't worry, they didn't forget it.

Can't beat the hours and you won't be disappointed by the pizza.
This place is goated for late night eats in the avenues when everything else is closed. I love how its open til 1am. And they got a big menu the food is hella good. Look at how fat this burger is.

The pizza here sucks.

New April 2026 review: My pesto slice here was big, floppy, and dripping with oil and cheese. It was folded and crammed into a box too small. I did not finish it. If you like the idea of pizza and you're hungry at night, you can come here because nothing else is open. Otherwise, stay away.

Original review: Tasty pizza and clean looking place but service can definitely be better.

I walked into the empty place and was told to wait for a minute. After ordering, I saw one of the staff go to the bathroom and come out like 30 seconds later. Definitely not long enough to have washed his hands. The place looks pretty clean and there's a nice mural inside. The pizza was nice and hot. The crust had a good crunch and the pepperoni slices were crispy. The cheese was stretchy, not congealed. Overall, a nice slice. It cost $3.60 which became $3.98 because of tax and a surcharge.

Yummy & halal!

My partner didn't eat pork but i LOVE all meats pizzas. This way so fantastic to have a place that allowed us to share without being concerned about the meats

The front person was super friendly
He suggested the special and we did half and half with the Tijuana. This was perfect as my partner preferred the tj and i preferred the special

We were deciding which side to get and he suggested the mozzarella sticks and they were the star!! So good and stayed hot on our drive all the way to marin

So excited to know there's a halal late night pizza spot!

2026 update: Love Seniores Pizza! This is my first time dining in. My order was the Seniore's Burger Special $14. The service was excellent. The young man behind the counter was helpful. They don't have complimentary water if you dine in but bottled water is available for a charge. You can also order via ipad. They were busy on a Saturday night and my burger took over 20 minutes to come out. They serve it via to-go containers even though I told him it was dine-in. So, not a great place to bring a date. The patty was dry. At least it comes with a lot of ketchup and mayo packets to make this edible. My mouth was really dry from the lack of water. Fries were good. The Seniore's Burger didn't come with the usual burger stuff like lettuce, tomatoes or onions, instead it had grilled mushrooms, onions and bell peppers. Next time, I'll just order a cheeseburger which comes with lettuce, tomatoes and onions. Kind of unsatisfied, I ordered a medium Pesto Chicken (Pesky Chicken) $28 for to-go. That's my jam.

Updated review 7/17/2022: Back when I lived down the peninsula, my favorite pizza parlor was the old Seniore's in San Bruno where they sold slices. As a single guy, it is tough to eat an entire pizza. I don't want to commit my meals for next few days. Now that I'm in San Francisco, I do miss Seniore's pesto chicken pizzas. Tonight I had their pesto chicken large pizza $31 (called pesky chicken). It is very good. It starts with a white garlic sauce with chicken, ham, onions, pesto and spinach. The crunch from the onion pieces were especially good. Great job pizza chef at Seniore's.

Original review: Seniores Pizza is perfect for those late night hunger pains. They are open late, like 1am. I remember getting their slices back in the early 2000's after clubbing or after study groups. Tonight they messed up my order. I ordered a large Pesky Chicken (white sauce, chicken, onion, bacon, spinach and pesto) but received a Chic-O-Roni (white sauce, chicken, pesto and pepperoni) $32. No biggie. Stuff like his happens. At least I got something similar as supposed to something weird like a pineapple jalapeno pizza. I especially enjoy their white sauce chicken pizzas. My favorite from their San Bruno location before the restaurant burnt down was their chicken garlic. So good.

Sunflower Garden SF Review

Sunflower Garden is a hidden gem in SF! The food is fresh, flavorful, and served in generous portions. Their Vietnamese dishes, especially the pho and garlic noodles, are delicious and well-seasoned. The atmosphere is cozy, and the staff is friendly and welcoming.

Service is quick, making it a great spot for a casual meal. Prices are reasonable for the quality, and it’s a solid choice for anyone craving authentic Vietnamese food. Definitely worth a visit!

Arguably the best vegetarian pho in town!

Our overall experience was delightful. The hosts were warm and welcoming. The food came out quick and everything was packed with flavors and delicious.

Must try (vegetarian/vegan):
Pho (You cannot go wrong with any Pho)
Fried rice

The pho is decent by SF standards, but nothing exceptional. The vegetarian basil chicken and the tofu vermicelli bowl was really good, but the fried spring rolls were absolutely incredible.

Our food was ready fast and the people working there were really nice, especially for me picking it up 10 minutes before closing (oops).

top_reviews.content: I came here for dinner, and this restaurant specializes in Sichuan cuisine, featuring a menu with a wide variety of authentic dishes. I chose some of the most popular items, which were absolutely delicious. The portions are generous, offering enough food to share or take home, as they are quite large. There are some restrictions on dining options; for example, I wanted to order a few hotpot dishes but I couldn't finish eat everything at the restaurant. Nonetheless, I enjoyed my experience and will definitely return for more. The price is good for SF area. Waiters are tentative.

Got 2 bowls of beef noodle at dinner time, the food is pretty good and the portion is very big for a normal person. What is frustrating is their non-existence service, we have to walk to counter to get the menu ourselves, very slow ordering, very very slow serving time. Even though it is dinner time on a weekday, only less than half of the restaurant is full. We wasted so much time waiting for this bowl of beef noodle, pretty crazy.

We just ate here in person and ordered more takeout today. My partner and I are super upset that the bag they gave us broke while we were walking and all our food and leftovers fell on the floor. We carried the bag normally with its handle and it ripped from the bottom. We are quite devastated because this was going to be our meal tomorrow. We are upset they gave us a bag that couldn’t hold the weight of our food. We called in telling them what happened seeing if we could get another meal and come in, but they didn’t understand and told us to order and pay when we get there again. This made us even more sad because we don’t eat out that often, so we were super excited to be able to bring food home. We love this place and order from here all the time. Their food is really good that is why I’m giving this review a two star instead of one, but the bag ripping was super sad and really affected the way I look at this restaurant.

Spices is absolutely amazing. My partner and I went with a friend and ordered the orange chicken, seaweed, braised chicken with chili pepper, and the fish fillet bowl with flaming red oil, and every single dish was bursting with flavor.

The orange chicken was crispy and perfectly balanced, the braised chicken had that deep, spicy kick you hope for, and the seaweed was surprisingly flavorful and refreshing. But the standout, without question, was the fish fillet bowl. It came out sizzling hot, coated in a rich, fiery red oil with layers of spice that changed as the dish cooled, every bite felt like a new experience.

That said, this is not the place for anyone who can’t handle heat, the food definitely packs some fire. But if you love bold, complex flavors, this is the spot for you.

The service was a little lackluster, but the food more than makes up for it. Don’t hesitate to ask for what you need, it’s worth it. I’ll definitely be back. This place is crazy good and absolutely a must-try at least once.

top_reviews.content: Great experience. The food is beautiful and delicious. As soon as you walk in you know you’re in for a treat as so much has been done to make this a beautiful space and the service is top notch. We had the Pave Potatoes to start which came out like a color sculpture with perfectly crispy edges and soft insides draped in a bright orange pepper sauce. The entrees were good sized portions, rich in flavor and plated well. Their Pisco sour was spot on and the Lucuma ice cream was a great way to finish the meal

Service was impecable from the moment we entered the restaurant. We had the ceviche verde, papas a la huancaina and anticuchos de corazón. The cocktails were sublime, and the mocktails were just as good and refreshing. From the host, to the bartenders, to all the servers everyone was fantastic. Highly recommend it. It truly reminded me of being back in Perú!

Absolutely love this gem.  First walking in we were in love with decor. The style is warm,  modern,  and just stunning.   The food was incredible!  We had a few apps (sorry can't remember the names) potatos, wontons and for mains empanatas, short ribs and paella. For dessert we had the passion fruit meringue, amazing!  Every dish was beautifully plated and tasted even better! Definitely going back.

I find you often have to choose between aesthetics and culinary prowess, with few exceptions. Lucuma is one of those exceptions. The food is as refined and delicious as it is instagrammable. Plus, most dishes are vegetarian and delicious on their own, with an option to add meat if that’s your thing. To boot, the service is phenomenal. Everyone working there was kind, attentive, and helpful — in person and online. 12/10, would go back in a heartbeat. PS: It gets busy, so reserve on OpenTable.

Lucuma Kitchen is a Keeper!

Open only 6 months, and it is very hard to get into this hot place in Oakland! We slipped in for Happy Hour on a Friday, and we're very pleasantly surprised. A warm welcome, nice seating, and delicious tapas with tasty drinks...what more can you ask for?

We ordered ceviché classic, ceviché verde, yucca fries, plantain chips, and pork sandwich. Ceviché classic was okay, but we really liked the ceviché verde. And the fried plantains. And the yucca fries. And... you get the idea.

Our server, Vanda, was fabulous! Attentive, yet not obtrusive. When she went on a food delivery, the other staff seamlessly stepped in and supported her. A very pleasant experience.

Make reservations in advance, as walk-in seating is nigh impossible to get. And enjoy!

We were staying nearby with our teen grandkids and decided to try North Beach Pizza through Uber Eats. The entire order was delivered right to our hotel lobby piping hot and incredibly fresh, which set the tone for a great dinner together.

I ordered the Delores Pizza (small), topped with creamy garlic sauce, ricotta, arugula, bacon, and a drizzle of hot honey. The combination was unique and absolutely delicious—the balance of savory bacon with the slight sweetness of the honey really stood out. The “small” was so generous I could barely eat half!

My wife chose the Spaghetti Aglio e Olio, which came with garlic bread. She felt the pasta leaned a little too dry for her taste, but still enjoyed the garlicky flavor.

Our grandkids went for a small cheese pizza and the Spaghetti & Meatballs. Both were big hits—the cheese pizza was extra cheesy and satisfying, and the meatballs were tender, hearty, and really well-prepared. Each pasta dish also included garlic bread, which made for a nice touch.

Overall, this was a very enjoyable meal for all of us. The large portions, great pizza, and fresh, hot delivery made it an easy win for dinner. We’d definitely order from North Beach Pizza again the next time we’re in San Francisco.

I recently returned to the city about 20year absence.. I had occasion to try out an old memory spot by Kezar and it did not disappoint at all.. I had my favorite Coit tower!! Just as I member it!! Thanks guys..

We always get pizzas delivered from North Beach Pizza. The dough is always perfect (crispy on the crust and bottom, but tender on the inside), ingredients taste fresh, and how the ingredients are assembled on the pizza's always balanced. I've tried other pizzerias and none have measured up. A big shout out to the team on Cole and Stanyan!

I ordered a chicken pesto calzone and it was sooooo good. I got the personal size and it was much bigger than I expected, which was great! It came with a side of red sauce and I only with I had more of it because I loved it!

top_reviews.content: The food is delicious; I’ve found authentic Vietnamese flavors right here in San Francisco. I love the décor. I’ve tried various dishes and have been satisfied with all of them. I’ll definitely be back with family and friends. The staff are friendly and enthusiastic, and the restaurant is lovely, situated on a lively street corner.

Started with the spring rolls and peanut sauce. Prawns were tasty and the sauce was the sweet, salty, not spicy at all. Really good.

For the main, got the wok fried lemongrass chicken with garlic noodles. The lemongrass flavor hits you upfront. Chicken was cooked well and portions were generous. The garlic noodles were lighter, which balanced things out nicely.

Also got the iced Vietnamese coffee. Strong, sweet, comforting

Staff was friendly and laid back. The only downside to this place was that it felt too pricey.

I recently dined at Hoi An Restaurant and had a mixed experience overall.

We ordered the imperial rolls, grilled pork with rice, and the Mediterranean sea bream (cá chiên). The imperial rolls and grilled pork were enjoyable well-seasoned, satisfying, and what you’d expect from a solid Vietnamese spot.
The fish, however, was a different story. It was fried to the point where there was almost no moisture left, making it very dry and quite difficult to chew. It ended up being inedible for us. That said, it may be a traditional preparation style that we weren’t familiar with, so it caught us off guard more than anything.
Overall, some dishes hit the mark, but the fish was a miss for us. If you go, I’d recommend sticking with the more classic items on the menu.

address: 1205 Park St, Alameda, CA 94501, United States

google.name: Spinning Bones

google.description: A contemporary locale known for rotisserie meats & American sides, plus a few vegetarian items.

top_reviews.content:
Opting to sit outside in the outdoor seating parklet because of the beautiful weather turned out to be a great choice. The outdoor area at Spinning Bones is comfortable, exceptionally clean, and offers fantastic natural daylight that makes the food look incredible. It provides plenty of space and fresh air, making it a perfect setting for a relaxed meal.

The meal kicked off with the sweet yellow corn fritters, which are every bit as good as they look. They have a perfect, satisfyingly chewy texture and taste amazing paired with the strawberry jam, creating a really nice, bright contrast between the crisp, golden-brown exterior and the sweet fruit. Next up were the smashed potatoes, which are an absolute must-order for the table—add these with the sour cream and you simply cannot go wrong. They come piled high with plenty of crispy, roasted edges, capped with a smooth quenelle of sour cream and fresh chives, all sitting over a rich, savory romesco sauce.

For the main course, Trip’s Triple Platter proved to be an excellent choice for a high-protein option. All of the meats—the rotisserie chicken, slow-roasted pork shoulder, and sliced tri tip—were perfectly cooked and incredibly tender. The presentation on the tray is a literal feast for the eyes, smartly rounded out by a crisp napa cabbage salad and two excellent, vibrant dipping sauces, including a standout herbaceous chimichurri, that balance the rich proteins beautifully.

The chocolate torte provided the absolute perfect ending to the meal. It is a dense, smooth torte sitting on a crispy oatmeal and puffed grain crust, topped with big flakes of Maldon sea salt that catch the light and cut through the rich chocolate. Overall, Spinning Bones delivers an excellent, flavorful take on casual rotisserie with a great balance of flavors and textures, and utilizing their outdoor seating was a fantastic place to experience it.

First time here and I was immediately greeted by Patrick, our server who provided my party with great recommendations of food and desserts to try. I was immediately surprised by his preparation of cocktails in figurines that I found out came from either Trader Vic's or Benihana. My Uncle worked for years at Trader Vic's and seeing the figurines took me back to my childhood and early adulthood visiting my relative and eating at Trader Vic's. This place has received Michelin recognition from 2021 - 2024 and is well deserved. We tried their Trip's Triple which consisted of their slow roasted pork, beef and chicken with a side salad. All were tender and excellent in taste. Because they do not smoke their meats, the natural flavors of the meats are the star. I almost forgot what slow roasted meats tasted like since much of the places I go to smoke their meats. You need to try what naturally slow roasted meats taste like. Their natural flavors are more intense. We also tried their corn fritters with the strawberry jam. Excellent combination. Crunchy corn outside but tender inside like a tater tot but not nearly as oily or greasy. The strawberry additional layer of complexity to the flavor. For dessert we had the butter mochi. Really, really good. The mochi had a consistency of a thick custard that is easily eaten with a spoon. The pineapple just added to the flavor and took me back to Hawaii! We rounded the dessert with their pour over coffee that uses condensed milk. One of the smoothest coffees I ever had in a very long time. Depending on what you order, entrees can pricey.

The atmosphere of this restaurant is a mix tropical and modern mix. With an outside parklet for outdoor people watching dining. Street parking can be difficult. Overall an excellent experience that deserves their Michelin recognition. Very highly recommended!

I got Trip’s Triple, the brussel sprouts, and butter mochi. The Trip’s Triple came with rotisserie chicken, pork shoulder, tri tip, a salad, and 2 different chimichurri sauces. My favorite was the pork shoulder, and the sauces complement the meats very well. The brussel sprouts were tossed in a creamy kimchi sauce. The butter mochi was a nice warm dessert to complete the meal. My friends enjoyed the ribs, burger, and fried rice. Overall, would come again!

Had the most wonderful Lunch here. Our server, Patrick went above and beyond, he was kind and attentive. The food was all delicious. I am not even a big meat eater but maybe I would be if it always tasted as good as this. I really appreciated that the savory dishes were actually savory and not sweet. Thank you spinning bones!

It feels great to be back at Tower Burger after 12 years! My bestie and I ate here for dinner on a foggy Sunday evening. It wasn't too busy at 5:30pm, but it got busier as it approached 6pm. We used to eat here for lunch on special occasions or for dinner before a show at our high school. The ambiance significantly changed for the better as it became modern with updated tables and gray chairs.

Ordering was easy at their counter, and the staff on duty kindly writes it down including specific requests. I ordered a California Burger without cheese and tomatoes, while my friend ordered a hamburger. There's an option to add fries for approximately $4.99 to your burger orders. After placing and paying for our orders, we were able to sit at any table. Our orders were ready within 10 minutes. The burgers were perfectly charbroiled and were delicious and not heavy. It suited well with the avocado slices, lettuce, red onions and the toasted buns. The fries were crispy and not greasy. It matched well with a side of honey mustard sauce (as per my request). The quality has sustained well since my high school era. Tower Burger is the legit OG place for burgers in the Twin Peaks-Miraloma area!

top_reviews.content:
We were reminiscing about our trip to Oaxaca and immediately started craving the food. So, we headed to Donaji, a Michelin-recommended restaurant near our home, and it did not disappoint.

Ambiance: The moment you walk in, you feel like you’ve teleported back to the colorful streets of Oaxaca City. To match the great atmosphere, the service was great.

The Starters: We ordered the guacamole with chips and the Ensalada. Not only were they fresh, colorful, and incredibly flavorful, but we also had the option to add chapulines (grasshoppers) to both, which instantly brought us back to Oaxaca.

The Heroes: For our mains, we chose the Tlayuda Oaxaca and the classic Donaji Enchiladas. The enchiladas with chicken tinga were phenomenal; they're a crowd favorite for a reason. If you're looking for authentic Oaxacan (20-ingredient) mole, this is the dish for you. The real surprise of the night, however, was the Tlayuda. This has to be my all-time favorite Tlayuda. Donaji does steak well; add chorizo, Oaxaca cheese, and fresh California produce like tomatoes and avocados, all folded in a thin, crispy homemade tortilla… chef’s kiss!

The Pairing: We paired dinner with a Malbec from Querétaro (central Mexico). The wine's bright, fruit-forward tones were a perfect complement to the complex flavor profile of the traditional cuisine.

Verdict: An incredible neighborhood spot with phenomenal service and authentic flavors. We will be back to try other dishes.

To focus on the positives: the fried tofu block with Tàishi Pàocài was perfection. What I imagine little drops of heaven taste like 🥰. The eggplant noodles were good, we had mixed opinions on the noodles—very good or slightly under cooked depending on who you ask; the eggplant had a unique flavor profile that was unexpected and eggplant lovers will love 🍆🤤.

It ended up being a fun night 😉

One less pleasant part of the experience was the wait time and lack of reservation system for small parties. We waited about 10 min to check in, then waited in the back for 15 min, then finally got to our table and only ordered 5 min later. The food came out in only 10 min, but gosh I felt like I was a freight train 🚂 being schleped around like that.

reviews_snippets.content: "A great experience, I like the food, atmosphere and service 💕Thank you"
"The absolute nicest people, delicious food, fair prices, nice ambiance."
"The restaurant had a great atmosphere lots of a large selection of beers."

top_reviews.content: Tasty authentic Japanese ramen. Spacious and friendly staff. The menu is not crazy extensive which means they are great at perfecting their recipes. A must try if craving Coco's in Japan. Oh yeah, there is also karaoke and you can sing while you wait for your meal!

Great little hole in the wall. It feels like all the karaoke places have sleeper adeles and lewis capaldis so it was refreshing to see with actual beginner singers.

Curry was good. Karaage was better. The atmosphere is what you're coming here for.

Pretty reasonable prices, especially during happy hour. The ordering QR code quickly got us food and beer, though the ordering site didn't show the happy hour prices. Facility was pretty non-sketchy.

Karaoke setup left something to be desired. Song collection was middling quality. There were a lot of things we wanted to sing that weren't in their catalog but we would've expected. The song browsing interface sucked and you can't view it on your phone. Get with the times and get a modern phone-browsable karaoke! It wasn't the worst karaoke place (that honor goes to Pandora), but it's inferior to many I've seen.

Overall a fun time at a pretty reasonable price!

Service really made the difference in here. Makao and Steven were very attentive with our food keeping us updated and went up and down with what we needed.
We had a really good time because of them. Great place to catch up with your friends and have some beers. They also had karaoke and if you are into anime, this would be the place.
Food was also really good, even if the kitchen was about to close, it tasted right! Would definitely come back :)
Spam fries and the Locomoco were great! It's a bit loud but the closer you sit to the window the less loud it is. Service was super friendly and fast. Def coming back again soon!

reviews_snippets.content: "Great place in Polk Street area to have tasty food and do karaoke!"
"Kalua Pork on nachos or in a burrito is an out of body experience of food Love!"
"Service was slow, food is salty, curry was just normal safeway curry"

top_reviews.content:
We had a great experience with Canton Restaurant! We ordered Mongolian beef, General Tso’s chicken, minced chicken with cream corn soup, and steamed rice—everything was fresh and delicious.

We were a bit disappointed the dining room closed at 8:30pm, but they were still kind enough to let us order to-go. Great food and service—we’ll definitely be back!

I ordered take out, but you could feel the so so atmosphere. But nevermind that! I ordered the chicken chow mein. Hands down BEST EVER. Spot on taste, flavor, freshness. Amazing. I didnt think I could eat it all. I didn't want to stop. Every bite was bursting with fresh flavor and I mean FRESH. I am extremely picky and always skeptical. This place was such a pleasant surprise. So good and so FRESH. My gargantuan sized chow mein stayed hot the entire time. I can't wait to order something new next time!

Ordered the sweet and sour pork, the pork was moist and tender.  Also ordered pork pot stickers were they were very tasty too. The two lady's that greeted me were very sweet and friendly.
I was staying at the Hampton Inn, across the street. It was nice to find great food so close by.🥰

I like the Buddha delight. I always order this with other plates. Ordered wor won ton. This is another of my prefer plates in here. Ordered the combination chow mein, which only had one shrimp, and black mushroom with bitter melon… they can change some vegetables for another if you ask them. The Chinese style food is always recognizable for its distinctive Cantonese flavor
Fast, friendly service. Been coming here for years. Consistent, high quality food. Can do many dishes vegetarian. Can also make custom dishes upon request. Family & kid friendly.

reviews_snippets.content: "Walk over for dinner, lamb in clay pot, spicy eggplant and seafood fried rice."
"The Service is Great..The Food is Fresh and Dim Sum portions are Good.."
"Also ordered pork pot stickers were they were very tasty too."

name: Bamboo Restaurant

top_reviews.content:
I did what I knew was wrong, ordered between 3-5pm. I suspect the good cooks are on breaks between " rush" so the Dishwasher did the cooking. Also,  this place serve sushi etc .

Porkchop was burnt.
Fried buns was burnt
Fried banana was gross

Grubhub issued a refund but that did not make up for having to order other food.
If you want repeat customers,  you need to stagger schedule of good cooks so good quality is consistent.

We had dinner here tonight. The food was fantastic!! The service was great! It was a very nice place with reasonable prices. We both had the combination plate with orange chicken. We upgraded to fried rice and Chow mein. Our total was $44 plus tip. They started with hot tea, then soup, then the main plate of food.

I highly recommend this place!

I was just visiting San Francisco and me and my dad were looking for something to eat and stumbled upon this place. First off the food was amazing real authentic Chinese food. But most importantly the atmosphere was fantastic. Both the servers were great people who offered us to sing karaoke and we said yes. We sang tons of songs and it truly was one of the best times ever. Great place totally recommend.

This place was very good. My family and I got the sweet and sour chicken, orange chicken pictured, chicken fried rice and chow mein. My favorite dish out of the bunch was by far the chow mein, the noodles were so soft and perfect with the sauce. IT WAS AMAZING. My second favorite was orange chicken which was flavorful, crunchy and tender all at once. Both chickens were very saucy with a combination of sweet, salty and tangy. Everything was good but the fried rice was my least favorite of them all. The food came in about 15 for all the things we ordered and the server was nice. Very small and intimate vibe with mood lighting which was nice. Overall 7.6/10.

We have been ordering delivery from Bamboo for probably 30 years and oddly have never been to the actual restaurant.  Good food and good service.  Very quick delivery and often the person that delivers is the same guy that has previously delivered.  Last time he was surprised that our dog Lola did not great him!  She is almost 18 and deaf so she didn't realize he was here!  The food never disappoints and one of our go-to dishes is the Honey Walnut Prawns.  The food is always consistent which in this day and age is rare.  Their menu is very extensive - and they have a great list of "Chefs Specials".  We usually order enough for several meals or a big crowd.  One of the few places that seemed to still be open consistently through the Covid lockdown and never missed a beat.  Last week when I went to order online the site said closed to delivery.  I called and they told me they were short staffed and when ready to order call back and they would get it delivered but it might take 45-60 minutes.  The food came in about 20 minutes!

reviews_snippets.content: "Place is great excellent service great food and it's really worth your money 👍"

top_reviews.content: first time here, went for the veggie with a few mods - on Dutch, toasted, mayo, mustard, oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, all the veggies except cucumber, and pepperoncini….. tell them u want the ohToya…. haha - the sandwich is magnificently delicious…. tried to save half it didn’t work 100 stars….

I got The Freak on Dutch crunch (served hot, I got no cheese and all the veggies except pickles). A really excellent sandwich!! The flavor was awesome and I definitely needed to use EVERY single extra napkin given to me. I walked around with sauce stains on my sweater all day and I don’t even care, the sandwich was THAT GOOD. I would say definitely get the pepperoncinis and jalapeños, they are a nice bright contrast to the savory pastrami brisket + bacon

Visited ~noon on a Thursday and there was no wait. There’s helpful signage on where to order and where to stand

🥪 🥖 🥪 🥖
#sandwichtour where I document my fave sandwiches and try new ones!

An additional charge for toasting the bread… come on boys, be better than that.

I love this place, love the sandwiches, love the guys working it. Been coming here for quite a few years and I often recommend it to others. However, was pretty disappointed to see an additional fee for “toasted bread” when I ordered today.

I’m used to prices going up in the city and needing to charge for add-ons, but in all my years of eating subs, a charge for ‘toasted’ is something I have never come across and feels like the definition of nickel and dimming the customer. Hope to be back soon once there is some reason behind these add-ons.

My gf found this online and boy (no pun intended), I'm glad she did.

The selection is wide, and to be honest, you really can't go wrong with any of them.

My gf got the Italian, which came packed with meats. I ended up getting the rated r (we both agreed it was the best one), and we also got a San fran psycho (when in SF).

The sandwich artists are professional, kind, and speedy. The price is also reasonable, especially with the amount you get. I couldn't finish the entire sandwich on one sitting.

I would return to this deli for sure.

Hands down the best sandwiches in the city and I ll stand on that! The quality of the fresh bread from Boudins and the amount of unique sandwiches on the menu helps them stand out. I love the rotisserie chicken and the rotating specials.

Prices range from 13 to 16 dollars but they’re big portions. The guys behind the counter are nice, don’t listen to the awkward encounters in previous comments below. Highly recommend trying if you’re ever on Polk.

top_reviews.content: I LOVE THIS PLACE - went for the first time and the flavors are rich, complex, multilayered, and simply glorious. The prices are perfect and the quantities are great. I couldn’t wait to get a bite in before I took the photos but I got the Aji Amarillo bowl and my hubby got the Pulled pork sandwhich (forgot what they called it). My dish was decadent, slightly spicy, full of delicious and juicy chicken, cheese, rice and potato. My husband’s sandwhich had the perfect balance of citrus which cut the yummy fat of the shredded pork. 10/10 recommend going. The alfajores for dessert were also scrumptious.

First time went there for happy hour the guy name Juan was very nice and they do have happy hours and close late so if anyone love wine and beer during happy hour form 3-7 come to this cool spot they play cool music and lot of cool food and snacks u would like I’m impressed of the garlic fries an fried bananas very delicious will for sure come back great customer service

Very unique for the area! It's down-to-earth food, but a nice breath of fresh air from all the Mexican and Chinese around the mission.

Got the pan con chicharron and it was a pretty decent sandwich. The pork was rich, peppery and braised to perfection. Fell apart in my mouth. It's perfectly paired with some pickled onions, and in case you're not a fan of the sour flavour, there's a whole sweet potato in the sandwich to ease out the flavour and add a hint of sweetness. Overall, great sandwich with incredible amount of layering.

That said, nothing crazy special, just a bit unique. A bit pricey, but it's the bay area.

I'll probably be coming back to try out their other dishes.

I don't usually leave bad reviews but I was incredibly disappointed in this place, complete waste of money. Had the Pan con Chicarron sandwich and fries, both were incredibly bland. The meat didn't taste like it was seasoned and the fries didn't even have salt on them. They also only gave me a little thimble of ketchup, the only thing making them edible.
Yucca fries were garlicky which was a fun new twist. The vibe is def takeout, but seating is available and cute. Get the spicy sauce, it’s soooo good.

top_reviews.content: Pho Huynh Sang is a nice, clean spot with friendly and quick service. The vegetarian noodle soup was flavorful and fresh, with a light broth that didn’t feel heavy. The rare steak pho had tender meat and a rich, comforting broth — classic and satisfying. The garlic noodles with shrimp were a standout — buttery, garlicky, and perfectly cooked shrimp. Overall, great flavors, generous portions, and a really pleasant place to eat.

Needing a quick tasty meal my friend and I decided on Pho Huynh Sang. The Fresh Shrimp Spring roll was indeed fresh. The beef pho we got was fine for my palate, but my daughter wanted it spicier and was able to add the heat.  The atmosphere is bright and diner-like, but does not add to the dining experience.

We stopped in on a Saturday at 2:50 pm - sign said closed at 3 pm, however, the server reassured us they would be open for another hour. We found our own seats and ordered pho and cafe sua. Both were delicious and filling. The server was very friendly and efficient. Would go again.
I love this place. It’s nothing fancy but the food is damn good. Been here many times over the past few years. Lots of gluten free options as well, though it’s not specifically listed on the menu.

I have been three times, new order each time, blown away EVERY TIME. Everything about this place knocks me out of the park. The service is impeccable, caring, funny, sweet, attentive. Something deeply familial and relaxing about being in this restaurant.....The quiet relaxing ambiance, the interior design. And the food is just perfect. Seafood pho is god-tier and my favorite thing so far - can't go wrong with veggie or tofu pho though. Spring rolls are great and fresh, mango salad slaps, want to be smothered in catfish claypot sauce.

Nothing like riding hawk hill or coming in from a freezing Baker beach dip to one of these red chairs and a hot bowl of broth.

Come here to heal. That is all my friends.

top_reviews.content: This is a lovely restaurant with a great ambiance and great service. I have a gluten allergy and I emailed ahead of time and they assured me they take measures to prevent cross-contamination and my server was knowledgeable about all the gluten-free options. I ended up playing it extra safe and just going with a beet salad with chicken (although they did have gluten-free pizza dough available) which was delicious! Our waitress was extremely detail oriented and attentive to our large party. We had a mix of adults and kids and everybody had something that they liked. I will say that two of the people in our party did not like the Cesar salad, although I didn't try it.

My wife Ellie and I stumbled upon Creekwood while visiting Berkeley this evening, and it turned out to be the perfect find — the kind of dinner that reminds you why you love going out. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere struck us: warm wood and metal, thoughtful lighting, casual yet genuinely refined. Someone with real design sensibility had a hand in this place.
The bar is great for drop-ins, the staff was wonderful throughout, and the ingredients in everything we ordered were fresh and inventive. We started with the winter salad — kale, pear, endive, lightly dressed — and it was exactly right. The mushroom pizza was delicious. Ellie had a glass of California Chardonnay and I had a Tuscan red blend; both were excellent choices for the evening.
We had the pleasure of meeting the owner, Greg, who has connections to Sonoma wine country — and it was genuinely fun to swap memories and talk shop. That kind of warmth from ownership shows up in every corner of the restaurant.
We'll absolutely be back. Highly recommend Creekwood to anyone looking for a neighborhood gem that punches well above its weight.

We were a group of 10 people, and owner Greg and the team took great care of us. Greg even went to the store to buy an extra umbrella!

Food was all really tasty

Amaaaaazing! Such a special neighborhood gem. We got and love the PEI mussels. Perfect amount of kick and couldn't get enough of that white wine butter sauce. The Margherita pizza and roasted beet salad also are must-gets. The salad has this yummy pistachio praline topping. I could eat that alone as a snack.

Service was warm and helpful, especially with the recommendations. I can't wait to be back and definitely want to try their brunch offerings as well!

Food was good, portions are decent, service was friendly and attentive. It was 5 of us and two babies with strollers. They were able to accommodate us on a Sunday about 5pm. It was slow when we arrived but much busier when we left, probably best to make reservations for dinner.

reviews_snippets.content: "Friendly staff, great ambience, tasty food and great owners!"

top_reviews.content:
This place was perfect! Ordered the calamari as an appetizer and it was amazing. Flaky and crunchy with a nice lemon zesty taste, it was perfect. I could have gotten another portion. The four cheese tortellini (not pictured) tasted as good the next day. The star was the espresso martini. Actually the BEST espresso martini I have ever had.

Our waiter was also super attentive and polite. The service combined with the sultry lighting and atmosphere makes it a great choice!!

The outdoor seating area is lovely and was the main reason I stopped by. Unfortunately, the service was quite slow and unattentive. The pasta was also mediocre—definitely not what I expected for the price point. It’s a beautiful spot for the atmosphere, but the food and service fell short. Half of the Brussels sprouts were burnt and extremely oily.

I had a nice lunch at Casaro Osteria. I had a  table outside with the perfect shade under the umbrella. The table setting was simple and elegant. It was the perfect spot for people watching.  I ordered the Arugula and Stawberry salad + prawns. It was so tasty and delicious! My server, Zev was a star. He was attentive and sweet. They have a full bar and menu. The prices are reasonable. The Osteria is managed very well.

First off, the outdoor parklet setup is the cutest! It was a gorgeous early evening, and we were seated outside. The food was absolutely fabulous!!! I can’t wait to come back and try more items on the menu!
I crave their Fungi pizza with Parmesan chips. And their beet salad is awesome too! Happy Hour prices from 12-4,M-F.

reviews_snippets.content: "The staff, food, decor, location and service were all top notch."

top_reviews.content: This is one of the most yummy places I have ever ate before. I was craving pasta and my boyfriend was craving pizza. We came upon this place and no one was inside. The service was amazing and we were taken care of by a nice lady. The food took 10-15 minutes to make and you could hear and see them prepare the food. IT WAS DELICIOUS. When I tell you that I am still hungry for pasta… I would eat my pasta dish every day if I could. Seriously. And my boyfriend’s pizza was yummy. I got some pasta with white sauce, bacon, chicken, spinach, and mushrooms. Will be back for sure

Me and my buddy were super hungry in SF and I wanted to have a local pizza , wow—this was hands down the best New York style pizza I’ve eaten outside of New York! The crust had the perfect balance of crispy and chewy yet still maintaining structural integrity and the toppings were absolutely loaded. (See video below!) Every bite was packed with thick, hearty fillings—juicy sausage, flavorful pepperoni, fresh veggies, and just the right amount of gooey cheese. Most pizzas with this thick of a topping get very soggy but the crust was still thin and crispy. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into their pizza!

I ordered takeout, and even after the drive after 10 minutes, it was still hot, fresh, and incredibly delicious. The person at the counter was super friendly and welcoming, making the pickup process quick and easy. It’s always nice when a great meal comes with great service, even for takeout!

This place is a must-try for any pizza lover in the SF area, especially the amount of food they give you. I’ll definitely be back for more. Don’t miss out on this sleeper hit of a restaurant, highly recommend!

We were looking for a pizza place in San Francisco. This place did not disappoint! Food was awesome!! Great customer service! The wings are amazing. We had the Valencia and Hawaiian pizza. Both were delicious. All the food had great taste. Will definitely be coming back.
We walked in on a whim and ordered! Great food and service! We ordered the meatball pizza. It was hot, delicious, and fresh!

It's been 5 years since my last visit! The remembers me! Wow! I've always order the all meat Calzone. I've ordered a couple of those when I worked for SFDPW yrs ago. Today, I'm ordering another one for my son, his girlfriend and me for tonight's dinner! This establishment has always been cordial, patient and inviting to me still after all these years!

top_reviews.content: Surprised how good the chicken tacos were here. Top tier. The lime hit so well with the marinated chicken. I gobbled them up quick. The chips and salsa were also top notch, along with the horchata and beef tacos. The shredded beef Birria tacos were also very good. Can't wait to come here again.

My boyfriend and I walked past this taco spot and immediately noticed it and decided we would be going there late night. After sitting at a local bar for a bit, we decided we were too excited for tacos to stay at the bar any longer. We immediately walked back to Suavecito to get late night munchies.

My bf ordered a birria burrito, I got birria and al pastor tacos. We shared chips and guac. It was the HIGHLIGHT of our night. We loved every bite. The owner noticed us vibing and asked our opinion. He was very sweet and appreciative of us RAVING over the food. I mean, we were literally happy dancing every bite. He gave us a fun drink as a token of appreciation and It was really really good (strawberry lime). Little things go along way!

Anyways, if you’re debating going here, stop debating and just GO. It won’t disappoint
Absolutely killer birria tacos! We also got the guac, carnitas tacos, and carne asada tacos. All were so delicious. The service was super friendly and fast. 10/10 would come back.

We ordered a streak breakfast burrito and it was the best we’ve had, maybe ever. Each mouthful was the “perfect” bite with a little bit of every ingredient. Salty from egg and potato, fatty from the steak, sweet and fresh from the tomato, and a bit tangy and fresh from whatever secret ingredient they’ve got in there…. Woah, and the green sauce was SO. BLESSEDLY. GOOD. Great start for a new business in Lower Nob Hill!! Five stars! One burrito with a side is enough to fill two grown adults with moderate to aggressive AM appetites. Also their staff is friendly, cheerful and very hard working. Only thing I wish is they would open earlier on weekends so I could get my fix around 7 or 8am.
Delicious quesabirria, cheese dip, horchata and hibiscus! The service was great, super friendly staff. Go here for authentic food. So good.

reviews_snippets.content: "Very good quality of food and service, music makes nice vibe!"
"Great staff, awesome food, great atmosphere 🎉 they also gave us a horchata!"
"“My left hand” ordered a trio of Crispy Chicken & Cheese Taquitos."

name: Seoul Garden
address: 1655 Post St, San Francisco, CA 94115, United States

google.name: Seoul Garden
google.address: 1655 Post St, San Francisco, CA 94115, United States

top_reviews.content:
Excellent, high-quality food. I loved the fried chicken. It had a very thin layer of crust, which was perfectly crispy without feeling heavy. It was delicious.

I also had the short rib soup, and it was very yummy. The portion was a little big, so it would be great for sharing. I used some of the meat from the soup with the complimentary rice and banchan to make a little bibimbap, enjoyed it so much :)

We also loved the japchae and the barley tea. Everything was excellent.

The server was really nice and friendly, and I appreciated the service. Unfortunately, I was disappointed with the food. I ordered the spicy pork, and it didn’t taste fresh to me. It honestly tasted like it had been sitting for a while or was reheated from earlier.

I also ordered an iced tea, but it had almost no flavor at all. It basically tasted like water with food coloring. The service was great, but the quality of the food and drink was disappointing. I probably wouldn’t come back.

Excellent food quality. Friendly service. I just came back from South Korea a week before and this restaurant food tasted authentic. The bachans (side dishes) were tasty. Fried chickens, oyster pancakes, bibimbap and ginseng chicken soup were all delicious with complex flavors. Best of all they were not salty and I didn’t need to reach for water for the entire meal. While the prices were higher than other places I think you get what you pay for with high quality of food.

Had a fantastic dining experience with my fiancé here. The service was awesome, our waitress was incredibly friendly and very attentive. The food was absolutely delicious, and amazing as leftovers too! The sides (all of the little white dishes) were only  $2.50 which is incredibly rare, and they were very good. We got the fried chicken with soy & garlic sauce on the side (super yummy) and the sweet & spicy fried chicken (the perfect amount of spicy). Super crispy on the outside and perfectly cooked inside and tasted very fresh. 11/10 would recommend. After we were done with our meal we were brought a very yummy complimentary matcha ice cream. We will be back! :)

Came here for am early dinner and the restaurant was empty. Like noone there but me and my girlfriend.

We ordered 2 bbq items and opted to not grill our food and just have it come out. The food was delicious and their banchan was also yummy. We had the brisket and galbi and it came out sizzling, plentiful but most importantly yummy.

We also had the fried chicken which is crunchy and the sauce wasn't overly sweet. It was a nice contrast from the beef. The chicken. Was juicy but there were some bone marrow fragments from cutting through the bone. Still it was tasty and I would have it again just be mindful.

The service was the best part. The guy was so friendly and charismatic. He was very attentive and made our dining experience fun because of how animated he was everytime he came to deliver food.

I enjoyed eating here and the fact we were alone until the end it was a nice vibe given how busy and small most reataurants are. Definitely a gem here in Japantown and worth a try even with all the other kbbq spots in close proximity.

reviews_snippets.content: "Legit Korean flavors, good prices and service, excellent drink options."

I've been here a few times, sadly each time has been disappointing.  Don't get me wrong the location is nice.   Service is decent. top_reviews.content: This place reminds me why I love living in the Bay area especially near San Francisco. One of the best if not top 4 sandwich spots in this beautiful city. We had both the Reuben and the vicking sandwichs and it was just an eye opener experience. Queue in the eye roll with every bite accompanied by a pretty shocked look that myself and my partner exchanged in disbelief 😁. Everything from the fresh, soft yet crunchy bread to the fresh ingredients inside the sandwich screamed quality followed by the right amount of delicious spreads and sauces. The place is a bit small for big hangout to be able to sit inside as there is only one  counter with three stolls but there is couple of tables on the outside that can fit a good size group if they are available. The owner is super nice and welcoming. You can tell that he takes the time and effort to make sure that his creations taste the way they intended to be.... Special, delicious and unique. Are you KIDDING ME? Right up there as one of the best sandwich shops I've ever enjoyed. Small, authentic, honest, currated, and lives up to everything others have shared here. If I lived in SF I'd be a regular.

Oh, and he serves Graffeo coffee too!

Great small sandwich shop. Fantastic quality cuts and perfectly baked bread. The owner is friendly and welcoming and always seems in a good mood.

top_reviews.content: This was our first time going to Holbrook House, where we went for lunch to celebrate a special occasion. The restaurant is gorgeous. Holbrook House has the potential to be a 5-star restaurant, but we rated it lower because of its amateurish, unskilled staff and very slow service given the high price point. We would have rated it lower, but management obviously recognized that what we were experiencing, especially for a special occasion, was below expectations and provided us with small servings of complimentary sparkling wine, a dessert & a bottle of champagne to take home, which was delivered to the table by the general manager. These actions demonstrated to us outstanding compensating hospitality. Having said all of that, the food was delicious. The Petite Seafood Tower ($125) had fresh & plump lobster, oysters and ceviche. Although the Black Truffle Grilled Cheese w/ Honey ($20) had no shaved black truffle, the black truffle taste is present & the combination of cheeses, honey & sourdough were the best I’ve tasted. The accompanying fries were crispy. All in all, we will return and give Holbrook House another chance.

I just want to start of by saying that the service was amazing. My bartender Chris I believe was his name did an amazing job catering to all our parties needs. Had great drink and food recommendations. That deviled egg was life-changing, it was perfectly paired with the cocktail he made for us. I haven’t been to a place in the city that has brought me so much joy in a while. I really hope that this establishment continues to grow and succeed. Excited to come back again and try more items off the menu and definitely more hand-crafted cocktails from this bartender. Amazing experience my husband and I will come back.

This restaurant should be on everyone’s MUST-EAT when in San Francisco. One of the most beautiful restaurant experiences we’ve ever had. The venue, the service and the food are just incredible.

Shoutout to Oswaldo for being a 12/10 server - he made us feel so special and taken care of. Thank you <3

We stopped into Holbrook House just to kill 20 minutes, but thanks to Raul, the super-friendly bartender, we ended up staying two hours. The cocktails were absolutely amazing — easily some of the best in the Bay Area — and the vibe was fantastic. Hernand, the manager, even came by to check on us, introduced himself, and was incredibly kind, which made the experience feel even more welcoming. What started as a quick stop turned into one of our favorite bar experiences in San Francisco. Highly recommend!

I stopped there for lunch. The dining room is elegant and cozy. The service is professional. The food is absolutely stunning. I started with Devil Eggs and Caviar, delicious plus a Caviar Bump, delicious!!!

My main course was a perfect Flack steak with frites, cooked perfect!
I closed with Huckleberry Yuzu Shortcake, so good!
I look forward to come back with my wife to share these amazing experiences!!!

top_reviews.content: This was my first time trying Haitian food and T’chaka was the right spot. It was a little busy when I entered and I chose to sit outside. Chris was the only person on the floor at that moment and he was busy running around to various tables who were paying the bill and asking for service. I was patient and Chris eventually got to my table. He was very hospitable and sat down with me to help me order. I ordered the tradition Griot plate with Passion fruit juice in the side. Chris was literally running from table to table handling different orders, a real hard-worker and tried to give everyone his best attention. Most appreciated. The dish was vibrant in color and beautiful in presentation. They definitely pay attention to detail. The pork was tender on the inside and crispy on the outside, a flavor I’ve never tried before. I really liked the spice in the dish, even the salad had a nice flavor. The portion size was great, well balanced. This was worth the wait, and I look forward to trying a new dish next time. Haitian hospitality is one of a kind and they treat everyone like family.

Food: five stars
Service: five stars
Ambiance: five stars
I ordered the oxtail and my vegetarian friend ordered the legume. The oxtail was so tender and fell right off the bone. Perfectly cooked and deliciously flavored. My friends’ legume tasted like a comfort dish you get at someone’s home. The rice and beans were perfect. I also got the ginger sorrel which is jamaica and ginger and it was so refreshing and *not too sweet*! The servers and workers were so wonderful and kind. Even everyone inside was sweet and asking one another what they got, was it good, etc… vibes were immaculate. The interior decor is cozy and cultural. I’m already looking forward to coming back and trying what everyone else around me got! Doesn’t seem like you can go wrong with the menu. This was my friend’s first time trying Caribbean/Haitian food and this was the perfect place to take him to. Thank you T’chaka for your hospitality and yummy food!

As a Haitian American who hasn’t had the opportunity to visit Haiti, coming here felt like home and incredibly special. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed. The beautiful artwork, atmosphere, and overall design of the restaurant made the space feel warm and familiar, and the food genuinely reminded me of home.

Everything tasted fresh and prepared with care. The owners were also incredibly kind and welcoming. I also loved the music! They were playing old-school R&B and soul when I visited, and it complemented the atmosphere perfectly.

The restaurant is in a beautiful area as well, so the entire experience was memorable from beginning to end. You can tell how much work and love goes into this place. If you’re in the area, I definitely recommend stopping by T’Chaka and supporting them. I’m so glad I got to experience it while visiting California. ❤️🇭🇹

We ordered the Legume with an extra side of rice & beans and plantains, not a crumb was left behind. The sorrel and sangria were delicious as well. Love the ambiance here, and enjoyed watching the match here with my kids.

Everything slapped. I’m Haitian and this is just as good if not better than the food I had growing up. Griot was perfect and I had no complaints about anything else. Also had the Empanadas (Haitian patty) and the jerk chicken. Pineapple juice was addicting only regret was not having a third cup.

top_reviews.content:
A cozy, relaxing restaurant and a true hidden gem of the Bay Area. It was featured on Check, Please! Bay Area, so it might ring a bell for those 'in the know" -- but I still almost want to keep it a secret!

The food is excellent, and so is the service. The chefs and staff are incredibly friendly.

I truly believe this is the best Peruvian restaurant in the Bay Area, if not all of California, the Western US, or even the entire country.

We made a reservation for a weeknight dinner at Pucquio to celebrate a family birthday, and it was really special. We prefer outdoor seating, so it was nice to have the option, especially accommodating our senior dog.

The service was exceptional – Kevin was our server, and we got to meet the owner as well. Kevin was really memorable, going above and beyond us to make us feel welcome and tended to.

We started with the cebiche and chicharron, and for mains, we split the lomo saltado, aji de gallina, and adobo de chancho. Everything was super flavorful! My favorites were the cebiche – super bright flavors – and aji de gallina – I could eat that every day.

For dessert, we tried their fried dough, which was a bit sour for our taste but super interesting.

The menu is pricey, so we would come for special occasions, but we would be so thrilled to enjoy their stellar food and service again.

Pucquio is one of those rare places that you remember long after you leave. The food is authentically Peruvian, prepared with precision, soul, and a true respect for flavor. Every dish stands out, but my absolute favorite is the Adobo de Chancho — tender, deeply seasoned, and cooked to perfection. It’s the kind of dish you crave again the next day.

One of the things I love most is that the kitchen is right in the background. You can see the chef in action, hear the movement, and smell the dishes as they come alive.

The dessert, the Combinado Clásico, was unforgettable — a beautiful trio of rice pudding brûlée, grilled pineapple, and purple corn sorbet. Elegant, balanced, and the perfect finish to a world-class meal.

And the service… truly amazing. Warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in making sure every guest feels taken care of.

Pucquio is a gem in Oakland, and honestly, worthy of a Michelin star.
A dining experience that stays with you — highly recommended.
Tried Peruvian ceviche for the very first time here and it was delicious. It had the perfect kick of spice and was bursting with bright, fresh flavor. Would recommend their fish ceviche.

On the recommendation of my son, a serious foodie and industry professional, I made a reservation for several friends and me to dine at Pucquio. Why didn't I know about this restaurant before? It is INSANELY DELICIOUS!

We ordered so many menu items and tried each dish. Every single one was perfect. There was so much love and joy in the food preparation and presentation. We had Lomo Saltado, Aji de Gallina, Adobo de Chancho, and Arroz con Mariscos. Additionally, we tried the Cebiche de Pescado, Yuca Frita (YUM!), and Salchipapas. For drinks we had the limonada and passion fruit beverages, plus some delicious calvados sparkling wine. Dessert was a sampler of all the sorbets.

The service, led by Kevin, was spectacular. He was warm, engaging, knowledgeable, and fun. We watched Carlos creating his culinary magic in the kitchen, too. I cannot wait to go back - make a reservation because it's gonna get busy!

top_reviews.content: Wow, the food here is REALLY good! I tried the Double-Cooked Pork Belly soup with ramen noodles and it's awesome. It's in a rich, super-flavorful broth with a complex blend of herbs and spices that make a perfect blend of savory, a little spicy, and a bit sweet from the scallions, ginger, and other stuff. There's a lot more going on here than a typical soup broth. Plenty of thick-sliced pork like super soft thick bacon strips that fall apart in the bowl.  Note - this type of pork does have a lot of fat (it's supposed to!) so if that's not your thing maybe try their wonton soup. Friendly staff and quick service. I highly recommend this place.

Really enjoyed our visit!

Fast & friendly service - there was a bit of confusion about how many soups we ordered but got it sorted out.

The bathroom seems to be upstairs so might be a challenge if there are mobility limitations.

Look forward to trying other dishes next time!

Food as medicine is central to Chinese culture and the food here is tasty and healthy Cantonese fare. Steamed dishes and classic herbal soups. Muted and subtle Cantonese flavors. Exactly the kind of nutritious food you would encounter
in any self respecting Cantonese household.

This place slaps my taste buds, I got lamb noodle soup (flavor), beef shank over rice noodles (succulent), shrimp dumplings (delicate), the chicken buns (the best). Get a rice or noodle dish and the all day dim sum

The event started at 5:00 pm, but I arrived around half an hour earlier yo snag easy parking in the surrounding neighborhood.  It's a 2 hour limit from 8 am - 6 pm, so it was perfect timing.

The bathrooms were in between buildings C and D and were clean despite so many people there.  A pop up bar was strategically placed in the middle of all the trucks and its seemed like almost everybody a drink in hand.  The only ones who didn't had young children in tow.

My only complaint: seating us practically nonexistent... The vibe was amazing though, so that made up for it.  Bring comfy shoes and be prepared to spend lots of money trying everything out!

top_reviews.content: Rang Dong is the ideal place when you have a taste for an  Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine Restaurant. Very friendly and genuine people here. Highly recommended! Ask for Alvin.

We were craving for vietnamese food, so we stopped by Rang Dong. I believe this place used to be in Oakland Chinatown. This restaurant is operated by a nice Vietnamese family. It was very clean and welcoming. The banh mi and fresh rolls were delicious. However, they did not use real beef broth for their pho noodle soups. You could tell that they used beef powder for their pho. I remember many years ago, they used to boil beef bones and make real pho broth.

I’ve had a few meals here and think it’s a decently priced place with tasty food. The shop owners are also really friendly.

I recommend the banh mis as they are flavorful and good value!

The last time I went my friend and I had the speciality soups which honestly were just okay. Nice and warming but the flavors weren’t as punchy as we thought they should be.

I’ll be back for banh mis and to try the pho. Good place to grab a snack or get some warm soup on a cold or rainy day.

Rang Dong is an awesome spot if you're looking for affordable grub! One dish you absolutely have to try is their Bo Kho, it is incredibly yummy. This beef stew is packed with flavor, thanks to a slow-cooked broth loaded with spices like cinnamon, star anise, and lemongrass. It’s rich, savory, and just the right amount of spicy.
The beef is super tender, practically melting in your mouth, and the broth is so fragrant it’ll have you hooked from the first bite. They serve it with either warm baguette slices or noodles ( had mine with noodles ), making it the perfect hearty meal. You can tell they use high-quality ingredients, and everything just tastes fresh and well-balanced.
On top of the great food, the vibe at Rang Dong is cozy and welcoming, it is definitely a small mom and pop business, The staff is super friendly and attentive. Whether you’re there for a casual lunch or a laid-back dinner with friends, it’s the kind of place you’ll want to come back to. If you’re craving authentic Vietnamese, Rang Dong and their Bo Kho are totally worth checking out!

I was craving noodle soup and came across this spot. Plus, I hadn't had Lanzhou beef noodles in a while, so it was great to find one in Berkeley!

I ordered the Signature Lanzhou Beef Noodles, which came with tender beef slices, hand-pulled noodles, broth, chili oil, and fresh cilantro. You can also choose your preferred noodle thickness. The broth was rich and fragrant, the noodles were perfectly chewy, and the beef was tender.

I also tried the Scallion Pancake with Sliced Beef. The pancake was crispy and filled with beef and fresh herbs, but it arrived cold, and the flavor was a bit too sweet for my taste. I'd skip this dish next time.

That being said, the Lanzhou beef noodles alone are worth the visit!

Had a wonderful dining experience here! We ordered the Big Plate Chicken with Hand-Pulled Noodles, Lamb Chops, and Lamb Pilaf, and every dish was delicious.

The Big Plate Chicken was full of flavor, with tender chicken, soft potatoes, and fresh peppers in a rich, savory sauce. The hand-pulled noodles paired perfectly with the sauce and were chewy and satisfying.

The lamb chops were incredibly tender, juicy, and had no strong gamey taste. They were easy to pull apart and tasted even better with the dipping sauce and cumin chili seasoning.

The lamb pilaf was also excellent. The rice was fluffy and fragrant, the lamb was tender, and the carrots and raisins added a nice balance of sweetness. The pickled cucumbers were fresh and refreshing.

The portions were generous, the ingredients tasted fresh, and the service was friendly and efficient. Great value for the quality and quantity of food. If you’re looking for authentic Xinjiang cuisine, this place is definitely worth visiting. We’ll definitely be back!

Highly recommend: Big Plate Chicken with Hand-Pulled Noodles, Lamb Chops, and Lamb Pilaf.

When asked where the other patty was he said well I have to charge you $3 per patty so I only gave you one. Who is this person to make that decision for me? Is he my financial adviser? I was also the only one in his section he asked for a credit card from before putting in an order. Just plain rude. But the missing patty was not the problem!!! The burger just is not good anymore! But hey for $22 you can have the smallest oysters on the planet. I used to love Low bar but I will never eat here ever again.

This place was fine. It’s a pretty basic bar/restaurant. The location is cool, the interior is small but chill. The staff was chill and laid back. The tequila selection is pretty mid. I had a great time because of the company I was with, but the food and drinks were just ok. There was nothing wrong with this place but there also wasn’t any reason I’d be dying to go back. If you’re just looking for a spot to drink and meet with people I think this spot is great. But for a fun and interesting meal? Probably not. It’s downtown Oakland so parking isn’t easy.
